title: Maintenance Automation Engineer
description:
### **Description**

Through focus in Controls and Automation Engineering, support ongoing production activities, participate in the improvement of existing processes, and assist in the development of new technologies.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Document, define, measure, and improve manufacturing processes using industry-standard automation and controls engineering techniques, including PLCs and database management.
* Ensure manufacturing processes, techniques, and tools are optimized to achieve quality and productivity objectives.
* Research, develop, and implement advanced manufacturing processes, methods, and automation technologies.
* Integrate and automate existing manufacturing systems and production processes.
* Drive and support continuous process improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
* Analyze process capability metrics and collaborate with Process Engineers to improve operational performance from a controls and automation perspective.
* Execute equipment and software installation, qualification, validation, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities.
* Improve equipment capacity, uptime, efficiency, and reliability to support production requirements.
* Develop and deliver process and equipment training programs and associated training materials.
* Analyze, specify, and implement cost-effective equipment solutions to improve operational performance and output.
* Track equipment costs, cost justification activities, and breakeven analysis for engineering projects.
* Support manufacturing process database management and troubleshooting activities when required.
* Maintain flexibility across working areas and independently manage assigned responsibilities.
* Support the Technical Supervisor in the training and development of technicians and team members.
* Assist with Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Analysis, and Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) activities.
* Collaborate effectively with Technical Planners and Maintenance Technicians to ensure smooth operations.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned objectives, deliverables, and project deadlines.
* Comply with all safety policies, procedures, and reporting requirements.
* Participate in departmental and company-wide initiatives to achieve operational and business goals.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Technology, or a related Engineering discipline.
  
Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience in Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, or a related field within a manufacturing environment. Experience working directly with production lines and manufacturing operations is essential.
  
Skills: Strong expertise in PLC troubleshooting, program modification, and development. Practical knowledge of industrial automation, robotics, pneumatics, mechanical systems, equipment validation, manufacturing process optimization, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  
Communication: Proficient in English with strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate requirements, specifications, project updates, and technical information effectively to technical teams and management.
  
Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively across production, maintenance, and engineering teams while coaching and mentoring engineers, supervisors, and technicians. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to perform effectively under pressure.
  
  
**Complementary skills**  
  

* Proficiency in AutoCAD.
* Experience with SolidWorks.
* Knowledge of SAP systems.
* Experience working within ISO-regulated manufacturing environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience supporting new product introduction and engineering change management

processes.

title: Sr. Automation Engineer - Playwright
description:
**Senior QA Engineer – Functional & Automation (Playwright)**
=============================================================

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a **Senior QA Engineer** with strong experience in functional testing and **Playwright automation using TypeScript** . The candidate will be responsible for test strategy, automation framework development, API/DB testing, CI/CD integration, and QA delivery in an Agile environment.

### **Must-Have Skills**

* **5–8 years** of QA experience in web-based applications.
* **3+ years hands-on Playwright with TypeScript** .
* Strong experience in **functional, regression, integration, smoke, exploratory, and UAT testing** .
* Experience designing and scaling **automation frameworks from scratch** .
* Strong knowledge of **Playwright, POM, cross-browser testing, and TypeScript** .
* Hands-on **API testing using Postman** ; knowledge of REST, SOAP, and Swagger.
* Good **SQL/database testing** experience.
* Experience with **Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps CI/CD** and Git.
* Strong knowledge of **ADO** – work items, pipelines, and test plans.
* Understanding of **STLC, Agile/Scrum/Kanban, risk-based and exploratory testing** .
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and **client-facing experience** .
* Advanced **Playwright MCP and Playwright Agent** experience.
* AI-assisted testing experience.

### **Good-to-Have**

* Prior **Selenium** experience with exposure to migration/enhancement to Playwright.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design and execute functional, regression, integration, and UAT testing.
* Build and maintain scalable Playwright automation frameworks.
* Automate UI and API test scenarios and integrate them with CI/CD.
* Perform API and database validation.
* Manage defects, QA reporting, and release quality.
* Collaborate with Product, Development, and Business teams.
* Mentor QA team members and drive QA best practices.

title: SDET
description:
**About Keka**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders. We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our Engineering team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in.

**The Role**

As an SDET at Keka, you’ll build reliable automated tests that help us ship with confidence. You’ll work closely with developers, product managers, and other members of the engineering team to understand how our products work and identify potential issues early. You’ll get the opportunity to work across UI, APIs, backend systems, and databases while developing strong engineering and quality practices.

**What You’ll Do**

* Understand product requirements and technical designs to identify potential quality risks and testing scenarios.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for UI and APIs using appropriate automation frameworks.
* Build and maintain reliable and reusable automation scripts for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Work closely with developers and product teams to identify issues early and contribute to a shift-left approach to quality.
* Perform API testing and validate backend functionality using tools such as Postman and REST clients.
* Perform database validation using SQL and ensure data is accurate and consistent across systems.
* Identify, document, track, and validate defects through resolution.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and help improve the speed and reliability of testing.
* Contribute to improving test coverage, automation efficiency, and overall product quality.
* Identify flaky tests, testing gaps, and repetitive manual processes and look for opportunities to automate and improve them.
* Participate in performance and security testing initiatives where applicable.
* Learn and adopt better testing practices, tools, and technologies as the product and engineering environment evolves.
* Collaborate with the engineering team to build a culture where quality is considered throughout the development lifecycle.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 1–3 years of experience in QA, SDET, or software testing with a strong interest in automation and quality engineering.
* Good programming skills in one or more of Python, Java, or JavaScript.
* Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or similar.
* Understanding of test automation frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or Mocha.
* Practical understanding of API testing using tools such as Postman or REST clients.
* Good knowledge of SQL and databases, with an understanding of backend validation.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Good understanding of software testing fundamentals, including functional, regression, integration, white-box, and black-box testing.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.
* Exposure to performance or security testing is an added advantage.
* You’re curious about how software works, enjoy finding what can go wrong, and bring strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn new technologies and testing approaches.
* You take ownership, communicate and collaborate well with developers and product teams, and are excited to grow as an engineer in automation and quality engineering.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Senior SDET
description:
**About Keka**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our Engineering team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in.

**The Role**

As a Senior SDET at Keka, you’ll build quality into every stage of the product lifecycle, going beyond traditional testing to think like an engineer and understand how systems work. You’ll work closely with Engineering and Product teams to identify risks early, build scalable automation, and strengthen our testing practices. Together, you’ll help us ship reliable, high-quality software with confidence.

**What You’ll Do**

* Analyze requirements, technical designs, and architecture to identify potential risks and provide early quality feedback.
* Design and implement robust, scalable, and maintainable UI and API automation frameworks.
* Develop, execute, and maintain automated tests across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios.
* Work closely with developers and product teams to embed testing and quality practices early in the development lifecycle.
* Perform API, backend, and database validation to ensure systems are reliable and behave as expected.
* Identify, investigate, document, track, and validate defects through resolution.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable faster, reliable feedback for engineering teams.
* Define and track meaningful quality metrics such as test coverage, defect leakage, automation efficiency, and overall product quality.
* Identify quality gaps, flaky tests, bottlenecks, and process improvements, and implement solutions.
* Contribute to performance and security testing initiatives where applicable.
* Mentor junior team members, share knowledge, and promote strong automation and quality engineering practices.
* Stay curious about emerging testing tools, technologies, and industry practices and bring relevant ideas to the team.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 4+ years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong focus on automation.
* Strong programming skills in one or more of Python, Java, or JavaScript.
* Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Cypress Playwright, RestAssured, or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of test automation frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or Mocha.
* Practical experience with API testing using tools such as Postman or REST clients.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, databases, and backend testing.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD environments using tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Strong understanding of software testing principles, including white-box and black-box testing.
* Exposure to performance and/or security testing is an added advantage.
* What We’re Looking For
* We’re looking for someone who thinks like an engineer, not just a tester.
* Someone who enjoys understanding systems and finding what could go wrong before it reaches the customer.
* You should have strong problem-solving and analytical skills, take ownership of quality from requirement to release, and be comfortable challenging assumptions and asking the right questions.
* You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders, so strong communication and collaboration are important.
* Most importantly, you should believe that quality is a shared engineering responsibility and enjoy finding smarter ways to build and test software.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Automation Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

ICE Mortgage Technology (IMT) is the leading provider for the mortgage finance industry. ICE Mortgage Technology provides best-in-class servicing solutions to help manage all aspects of loan servicing - from loan boarding to default. Transform your performance with automation and insights and enhance customer experience. Our solutions support first mortgages as well as home equity loans, and help servicers lower costs, reduce risk and operate more efficiently. We're looking for motivated, result-oriented people to join our team.

We are looking for an individual to be service oriented, delivery focused and can build rapport with key members of the Operations and SRE teams specifying and implementing automation changes, fixes, and improvement projects. The ideal candidate will have excellent time and customer management skills, be able to work autonomously on projects combined with a range of technical skills and knowledge.

**Responsibilities**

* Building and maintaining tools and solutions for our operations platform, ensuring that we meet our customer service standards and reduce errors
* Actively troubleshoot any issues that arise during testing and production
* Update existing processes and design new processes as needed to optimize performance
* Work with the customers to understand their infrastructure automation solution requirements
* Understanding customer requirements and project KPIs
* Actively participate in or own continuous improvement projects driven by automation
* Any other activities as directed by management
* Work closely with the other team members to improve existing projects
* Create quality measurements to track improvement in projects
* Provide technical analysis, resolve problems, and propose solutions in a 24/7 production environment
* Participate in an on-call rotation

**Knowledge and Experience**

* 3+ years functional experience working as a DevOps Engineer
* Prior experience with software development, infrastructure development, or development and operations
* Strong experience with Microsoft Windows Server and Linux Administration
* Experience with scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell
* Experience in architecting an automation framework
* Proficiency in Configuration Management, CI, and automation tools such as – Rundeck, Jenkins, Chef, Puppet, Ansible or similar
* Experience with Agile methods (Scrum/Kanban) to organize project deliverables, to track and to report progress (Jira)
* Experience with git, git repo services (BitBucket, GitHub), and branching strategies
* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools (Splunk, Nagios, BigPanda, PagerDuty)
* Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Experience with automation of business continuity/disaster recovery
* Knowledge of and exposure to container technology (OpenShift) and orchestration is a plus
* Experience interacting with REST APIs (GET/POST requests), webhooks, and API client tools (Postman)
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Process-oriented with great documentation skills (Confluence)
* Experience with data structures/formats such as XML, JSON, YAML, and HCL

title: Senior Test Automation Manager/ Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering

In this role, you will:

**The Opportunity**

Join our GPS PostProcessing GPI team to strengthen how we assure quality across critical payments and post-processing technology. This role focuses on setting a consistent automation approach across a geographically distributed engineering team and ensuring functional and non-functional coverage is built in from the start. You’ll create scalable automation frameworks and testware that can be reused across complex modules and business-critical components. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders you’ll remove impediments and resolve issues that impact delivery. Success means reliable automation coverage, clear reporting and predictable outcomes that meet agreed timelines and quality expectations.

**What you'll be doing**

* Oversee a geographically distributed team of test automation engineers and embed consistent automation practices
* Interpret requirements and define automation strategies that cover functional and non-functional needs
* Design, develop, debug and maintain scalable reusable automation frameworks scripts and testware
* Own automation delivery for complex modules and critical business components across supported environments
* Govern delivery against timelines coding standards testing requirements and quality expectations
* Review test cases and shape SIT OAT and UAT scenario definition to ensure coverage and traceability
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to resolve issues and remove delivery impediments
* Produce test reporting and contribute to peer reviews Agile ceremonies and continuous improvement

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate proven experience managing geographically distributed test automation teams
* Show substantial hands-on expertise in Selenium Java and API automation including scalable framework development
* Apply practical experience with BDD TDD CI/CD Jenkins Git and related testing tools and frameworks
* Translate complex business requirements into effective reusable and maintainable automation solutions
* Use strong debugging troubleshooting and problem-solving capability to unblock delivery and improve quality
* Apply clear communication and stakeholder-management skills across business and technology teams
* Work with coding standards test quality automation governance and continuous improvement practices
* Operate effectively in Agile environments using Scrum or Kanban and contribute to automation strategy and framework design

**Building quality into payments**

This is an opportunity to set the direction for automation across business-critical payments technology and see the impact through better reliability and faster delivery. You’ll work with teams across locations and disciplines to embed strong quality practices from requirements through to UAT. If you’re looking to build automation frameworks that scale and improve outcomes across complex platforms we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

title: Test Automation
description:
**Job Description:**

Essential Job Functions: Design, develop, and implement automated testing solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of software applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify testing requirements and develop test automation frameworks. Develop and maintain automated test scripts, as well as troubleshoot and resolve testing issues. Participate in the development of testing standards, processes, and procedures to improve overall testing efficiency. Work closely with development teams to ensure timely and effective testing of software applications. title: SDET I
description:
The DataX project is Verisk Maplecroft’s data storage and monitoring platform, written largely in the Python programming language and hosted on AWS. GRiD is Verisk Maplecroft’s web-based data delivery platform based on the Angular web framework and the Django Rest Framework. Both projects are presently in active development by Agile based project teams in the UK and are presently supported by a part-time test engineer who works across both projects.
  
The Test Engineer role will be flexible, detail-oriented, and skilled at working with internal customers (Software and Product Team). The Tester will champion the quality of our data and products via automated and manual tests, quality assurance and regression testing, proactive reporting and verification of bugs and/or data errors and will play a critical role in delivering the DataX and GRiD product visions.

**Qualifications:**

  

The Test Engineer will:
  

* Work closely with the UK-based Technical Project Manager to create test strategies and plans that provide acceptable coverage for a given dataset or product
* Attend requirement gathering meetings with Product and Stakeholders to better understand business needs, functionality and system requirements
* Work in an Agile delivery methodology
* Provide regular and open communication across the program for transparency of progress and roadblocks
* Take ownership of test processes and implementing them
* Coordinate with the Technical Lead and UK Technical Project Manager to align tests with requested timelines
* Produce detailed testing documents, including test scripts to automate and rapidly perform testing iteratively

  

* At least 3+ years of software QA testing experience
* Expertise on STLC , SDLC, Defect life cycle
* Must have strong knowledge and experience in Python programming language.
* Ability to design and develop the automation framework from scratch.
* Strong knowledge on Postman and Swagger tools.
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipeline.
* Experience in building frameworks using selenium, Requests and related libraries.
* Expertise in test management tools like Test rail/Browser Stack.
* Experience with version control systems like Git.
* Excellent and proven Troubleshooting skills
* Experience configuring, deploying and testing software updates
* Ability to identify issues and escalate as appropriate
* Ability to understand propagation of data through environments and components
* Familiarity working with APIs providing structured data
* Ability to communicate technical matters effectively to a variety of Stakeholders
* Familiarity working in an Agile environment and with Atlassian products, such as JIRA, confluence etc.
* Fluency and clarity in spoken and written English, being able to concisely communicate technical ideas internally and to UK/US staff
* Testing is conducted with 20% being manual and 80% automation.
* Expertise Knowledge on Figma tool.

**Nice to have**  

* Programming experience in language such as Python, Django
* Hands on experience on Docker
* SQL and database knowledge.
* GitHub / Copilot / Rovo etc. AI tools
* Any QA certifications.
